consequence.statement: Two new certificate timestamp metrics are now available. Nothing existing changes or breaks.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 adds two new Prometheus metrics for certificate issuance and expiration times: certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds and certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: No subject family fits a Prometheus metric, and the change names two metrics, so it has no single family identity; applicability: This only adds metrics. The evidence names no environment condition under which an operator is affected
